# CARFAX

> CARFAX is a comprehensive automotive marketplace and vehicle history platform enabling users to shop, buy, sell, and own cars with confidence through detailed reports and research tools.

CARFAX provides vehicle history reports, used and new car listings, valuation tools, auto repair services, and maintenance tracking across major automotive brands including Toyota, BMW, Chevrolet, Honda, and others. The platform serves as a trusted resource for car shopping, ownership, and vehicle research with accident history, recall information, and pricing data.

## Key Topics

- Vehicle History Reports
- Used Car Shopping
- Car Valuation
- Vehicle Recalls
- Automotive Marketplace
- Car Listings
- VIN Lookup
- Electric Vehicles
- Fuel Efficiency
- Car Brands
- Vehicle Comparison
- Auto Repair Services
- 2026 Models
- Hybrid Cars
- Maintenance Tracking

## Core Shopping & Marketplace

- [CARFAX - Shop, Buy, Own, & Sell Cars with Confidence](https://www.carfax.com): CARFAX homepage offering car shopping, selling, and vehicle history services
- [Used Cars for Sale | with Free CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/cars-for-sale): Browse used cars with free CARFAX reports, accident-free vehicles, and pricing
- [New Cars for Sale Near Me](https://www.carfax.com/new-cars): Search new cars, trucks, and SUVs by brand and location from CARFAX inventory
- [Used Acura Models for Sale (with Photos) - CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/Used-Acura_m1): Browse used Acura vehicles with free CARFAX reports and accident history
- [Used Alfa Romeo Models for Sale (with Photos) - CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/Used-Alfa-Romeo_m37): Browse used Alfa Romeo vehicles with free CARFAX reports and inventory

## Vehicle History & Valuation

- [Vehicle History Reports – Get a CARFAX Report](https://www.carfax.com/vehicle-history-reports): CARFAX Vehicle History Reports with ownership, accident, and service records
- [How Much Is Your Car Worth? Find Instant Trade In-Value](https://www.carfax.com/value): CARFAX Value tool for instant car valuation using VIN and history data

- [Best Sedans of 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-sedans): CARFAX rankings of best sedans by class with comparisons and buying guide

- [Best SUVs in 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-suvs-for-money): CARFAX rankings of best SUVs across classes with buying guide
- [Best Electric Cars in 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-electric-cars): CARFAX rankings of electric vehicles by price, size, and body style
- [Best Hybrid Cars of 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-hybrids): CARFAX rankings of best hybrid cars with fuel efficiency and features
- [10 SUVs With the Best Gas Mileage in 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-gas-mileage-suv): CARFAX guide to fuel-efficient SUVs with EPA ratings and comparisons
- [10 Trucks With the Best Gas Mileage in 2026 | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/rankings/best-mpg-trucks): CARFAX rankings of fuel-efficient trucks including hybrid and diesel options

## Maintenance & Services

- [Auto Repair and Maintenance Near Me | CARFAX](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair): Find local auto repair shops with reviews, hours, and service coupons
